BLACK_STAR.description: Elites drop an additional Relic. If obtained in Act 3 or later, immediately obtain 1 random Relic.
BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE.description: Gain 1 Energy. Add 1 Enthralled Curse to your deck.
BRILLIANT_SCARF.description: Every turn, the 6th card you play costs 0.
CHOICES_PARADOX.description: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of 5 usable Rare cards to add to your hand. It gains Retain and is removed after combat.
CHOICES_PARADOX.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose 1 Rare card to add to your hand.
CLAWS.description: On pickup, transform up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards into upgraded Maul.
CLAWS.eventDescription: Transform up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards into upgraded Maul.
CLAWS.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose cards to transform into upgraded Maul.
CLAWS.title: Tanx Claws
CROSSBOW.description: At the start of each turn, you may add a random Attack to your hand. It costs 1 less this turn and gains Ethereal and Exhaust.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.description: On pickup, lose 30% of current Max HP, at least 18. Add 3 Apparitions.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.eventDescription: Lose 30% of current Max HP, at least 18. Add 3 Apparitions.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.unpayableOption: Max HP too low to pay this cost ({Cost}).
ECTOPLASM.description: Gain 1 Energy. On pickup, gain 250 Gold. You can no longer gain Gold.
FIDDLE.description: At the start of each turn, draw until you have 7 cards. During your turn, draw effects cannot make your hand exceed 7 cards.
IRON_CLUB.description: Whenever you play 5 cards, draw 1 card.
JEWELED_MASK.description: On pickup, choose a Power. It permanently costs 0. At the start of each combat, move it from your draw pile to your hand.
JEWELED_MASK.ezSelectionScreenPrompt: Choose a Power to permanently cost 0.
JEWELRY_BOX.description: Add 1 Apotheosis to your deck. It does not have Innate.
MEAT_CLEAVER.description: Adds a [gold]Cleaver[/gold] option to rest sites: remove [blue]2[/blue] cards and lose [blue]5[/blue] HP.
MUSIC_BOX.description: Each turn, the first Attack you play creates a copy in your hand. The copy costs 1 less this turn and has Ethereal and Exhaust.
PAELS_HORN.description: Add 1 Relax and 1 Relax+ to your deck.
PAELS_TOOTH.description: Remove 5 cards. After every 2 non-boss combats, choose 1 stored removed card to return to your deck upgraded. After the act boss, remaining stored cards are removed permanently.
PRESERVED_FOG.description: Remove 4 cards. Add 1 Folly to your deck.
PRISMATIC_GEM.description: Gain 1 Energy. Every second standard card reward contains only off-color cards.
PRISMATIC_GEM.countHint.title: Prismatic count: {Count}/{Cycle}
PRISMATIC_GEM.countHint.nextNormal: Next standard card reward is normal.
PRISMATIC_GEM.countHint.nextOffColor: Next standard card reward contains only off-color cards.
PRISMATIC_GEM.rewardScreenHint: Prismatic reward: only off-color cards this time.
SEAL_OF_GOLD.description: Gain 1 Energy. Add 2 playable Debt Curses to your deck.
SOZU.description: Gain 1 Energy. On pickup, fill all empty Potion slots. You can no longer obtain Potions.
SERE_TALON.description: On pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]4[/blue] Curses. Add it, [blue]2[/blue] Wish, and [blue]1[/blue] Wish+ to your deck.
SERE_TALON.eventDescription: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]4[/blue] Curses. Add it, [blue]2[/blue] Wish, and [blue]1[/blue] Wish+.
SERE_TALON.title: Vakuu's Sere Talon
TOASTY_MITTENS.description: Before drawing each turn, view the top card of your draw pile. You may Exhaust it to gain 1 Strength.
EZMICROBALANCE-AncientInitialRerollOptio: Reroll the current Act 1 Ancient rewards once. The die appears only in Act 1.
A small die for the one choice you get to ask again.
EZMICROBALANCE-ANCIENT_INITIAL_REROLL_OP: Reroll the current Act 1 Ancient rewards once. The die appears only in Act 1.
A small die for the one choice you get to ask again.

A sealed token for the pact beneath the roots.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMoltingOptionRelic.de: Remove [blue]1[/blue] Strike and [blue]1[/blue] Defend, then add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Withered Husks[/gold] as a cost. Remaining [gold]Withered Husks[/gold] are removed at the start of Act [blue]2[/blue].
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMoltingOptionRelic.fl: A sealed token for the bark left behind.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMossMapOptionRelic.de: In Act [blue]1[/blue], the first room of each type entered grants a bonus: Monster +[blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; Event heal [blue]5[/blue] HP; Shop [gold]Potion[/gold]; [gold]Elite[/gold] upgrade [blue]1[/blue] random card; Rest Site +[blue]3[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMossMapOptionRelic.fl: A sealed token for the path hidden by moss.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaSeedbedOptionRelic.de:
Act [blue]1[/blue] normal card rewards can be replaced by [gold]Seedbed[/gold]: lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and add a [gold]Seedbed[/gold]. The first one is upgraded. Collecting [blue]4[/blue] grants [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
[gold]Seedbed[/gold] is a [blue]1[/blue]-cost Skill: gain [blue]8[/blue]/[blue]12[/blue] Block and set up [blue]2[/blue]/[blue]3[/blue] total spaces. On play, immediately plant up to [blue]1[/blue]/[blue]2[/blue] eligible cards from draw or discard; remaining spaces catch later pollution before it enters hand.
[gold]Planting[/gold]: before a card enters hand, remove it from this combat and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold]. It is not play, discard, or Exhaust, and it triggers none of those payoffs. Planted Temporary Status/Curses disappear after combat; permanent Curses are not permanently deleted.
Seedbed can plant [gold]Temporary[/gold] Status cards, [gold]Temporary[/gold] Curse cards, [gold]Blight Sprouts[/gold], and [gold]Rootblight[/gold]. A planted [gold]Blight Sprout[/gold] is handled for this combat: it does not enter hand, does not grow, and adds no [gold]Rootblight I[/gold]. A planted [gold]Rootblight[/gold] freezes this combat's end check only: no cleanse, downgrade, worsen, or split; same stage after combat.
Its value has three parts: [blue]8[/blue]/[blue]12[/blue] immediate Block, fewer pollution draws, and [blue]1[/blue] Husk per plant. Each Husk later Exhausts for [blue]3[/blue] Block.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaSeedbedOptionRelic.fl: A sealed token for a patient seed.

EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_TRIAL_BRANCH_OPTION_: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]4[/blue] cards. It is upgraded and added to your deck with [gold]Trial Branch[/gold]. You must play it in each of the next [blue]3[/blue] combats, or it will be permanently removed.
A sealed token with a green shoot through the verdict line.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_SHALLOW_ROOT_RELIC_O: Gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] common relics. Defeat an Act [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] to root it permanently and gain [blue]35[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. If Act [blue]2[/blue] starts first, the relic is returned and you are refunded [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
A sealed token whose roots have not found stone yet.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_ELITE_ROOT_OPTION_RE: After defeating an [gold]Elite[/gold], heal [blue]10[/blue] HP. Firemarked Elites also trigger this.
A sealed token that drinks from hard-won ground.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_ROOTED_ROUTE_OPTION_: Urda marks a reachable Act [blue]1[/blue] combat within the first [blue]7[/blue] floors. Reaching the [gold]Root Mark[/gold] grants [blue]3[/blue] single-card rewards (first is upgraded) and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if you have an open slot. Missing it costs [blue]8[/blue] HP and grants [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
A sealed token threaded with a route only roots can read.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_AFTER_RAIN_OPTION_RE: In Act [blue]1[/blue], the first time you take unblocked enemy attack damage each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rain Breath[/gold]. At Act [blue]2[/blue] start: if triggered fewer than [blue]3[/blue] times, gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; otherwise heal [blue]8[/blue] HP and upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card.
A sealed token still wet from the storm that spared it.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_ROOT_SIGHT_OPTION_RE: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Root Eyes[/gold]. Click this relic on the map to select and preview a future reachable Monster, Unknown, or Elite room. Hover the marked room to view its enemy group or event. The first preview grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if you have an open slot.
A sealed token with an eye pressed into living bark.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_SEED_BANK_OPTION_REL: Allows you to [gold]Store Seed[/gold] during Act [blue]1[/blue] card rewards to save up to [blue]3[/blue] cards. Click this relic later to add up to [blue]2[/blue] of those stored cards to your deck (the first is upgraded), consuming this relic.
A sealed token that rattles with future leaves.
Click this relic to choose up to [blue]2[/blue] stored cards. The first chosen card is upgraded.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_CLOSED_COURT_OPTION: Post-combat card rewards no longer appear. On Turn [blue]1[/blue]: draw [blue]4[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. On Turn [blue]4[/blue]: draw [blue]2[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
A sealed token from a locked courtroom.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_DEATH_REPRIEVE_OPTI: Once per run, prevent death from a fatal hit and set HP to [blue]1[/blue]. Take one final turn: draw [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and all cards cost [blue]0[/blue]. You cannot die during this turn; if any enemies remain, die; otherwise, continue the run.
A sealed token for one delayed final sentence.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_DEFERRED_VERDICT_OP: At the start of Turn [blue]4[/blue], draw [blue]4[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. Thereafter, each non-Status card spends [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]: [gold]Attack[/gold]/[gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue] card. If combat ends before Turn [blue]4[/blue], heal [blue]4[/blue] HP.
A sealed token waiting for the third exhibit.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_MIRROR_HALL_ECHO_OP: At turn end, remember the last card type played. Next turn, your first card of that type makes [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
A sealed token reflected from every wall.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_MIRROR_REBUTTAL_OPT: Choose [blue]1[/blue] mirror card from your deck. At combat start, move it to your hand after drawing. The first time played: [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue].
A sealed token that answers the first wound.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_PRESUMPTION_OPTION_: Start combat with [gold]Innocent[/gold]. At your turn start, if you are [gold]Innocent[/gold], draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Taking unblocked enemy [gold]Attack[/gold] damage removes [gold]Innocent[/gold], you lose [blue]8[/blue] HP immediately, and you cannot regain [gold]Innocent[/gold] for the rest of combat.
A sealed token from before evidence is heard.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_OPT: Your non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] stacks apply twice and grant [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. Enemy non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] stacks on you also apply twice; stacks applied to you are also doubled, but remove [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. At turn start, spend up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]: each spent stack draws [blue]1[/blue] and gives [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
A sealed token laid where all can see it.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_SINGLE_SENTENCE_OPT: Each turn, your first [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times. Afterwards, you may only play up to [blue]4[/blue] more cards this turn. [gold]Power[/gold] cards do not count towards this limit, cost [blue]0[/blue], and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
A sealed token written in one line.
Fight Vakuu in a greed trial. Break [blue]1[/blue] or more [gold]Stolen Locks[/gold] to cash out loot Gold and extra blessing choices. On turns [blue]1[/blue], [blue]3[/blue], and [blue]5[/blue], choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Contracts[/gold] to help break locks at the cost of increasing [gold]Blood Debt[/gold]. You may cash out after breaking any lock. No normal combat rewards. Death ends the run.
A warning and an invitation etched on the same blade.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_FORBIDDEN_LOAN_OPTI: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] upgraded [gold]Ancient[/gold] cards and add it to your deck. Playing it costs life: [gold]Attack[/gold]/[gold]Skill[/gold] cards cost [blue]1[/blue] HP, [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]8[/blue] HP. After the Act [blue]2[/blue] boss, pay [blue]180[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to keep it, or it will be removed.
A sealed token signed in the margin.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_MISPRINT_PRESS_OPTI: Once each turn, the first manually played deck [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] card plays [blue]1[/blue] extra time. If its printed cost is [blue]1[/blue] or more [gold]Energy[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card. [gold]Power[/gold], Status, Curse, autoplay, and generated cards do not trigger.
A sealed token stamped twice by mistake.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_RED_INK_OVERDRAFT_O: Each turn, add a temporary [gold]Overdraft[/gold] if hand space allows. Once per turn at [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], play it to draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and record [blue]1[/blue] [gold]red-ink debt[/gold]. Each debt costs [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] at combat end (or [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP if unpaid).
A sealed token whose ink refuses to dry.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_OVERDUE_LIBRARY_OPT: At combat start, add [blue]3[/blue] random temporary [gold]Archive Pages[/gold] to hand. Pages cost [blue]0[/blue] and are removed after combat.
A sealed token tucked behind the last shelf.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_OPEN_BOOK_EXAM_OPTI: On turn [blue]1[/blue], draw [blue]5[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. Extra-drawn cards left in hand at turn end are sealed in the [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], then return on turn [blue]3[/blue] as [blue]0[/blue]-cost cards if hand space allows.
A sealed token folded into a cheat sheet.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_PAPERSTORM_OPTION_R: At combat start, shuffle [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Waste Paper[/gold] Status cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Each turn, the first [blue]2[/blue] Status cards drawn from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] are consumed; each draws [blue]1[/blue] and grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
A sealed token caught in a rising stack of forms.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_BLUEPRINT_PROOF_OPT: At combat start, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Proofread[/gold]. Your first [blue]3[/blue] manually played deck cards get a one-play benefit: unupgraded cards temporarily upgrade and draw [blue]1[/blue]; upgraded cards cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
A sealed token corrected in blue pencil.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_DEBT_SETTLEMENT_OPT: Gain [blue]220[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, and upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards. Take [blue]320[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]. After each combat, repay [blue]40[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; for each [blue]10[/blue] short, lose [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP. [gold]Debt[/gold] drops by [blue]40[/blue] either way.
A sealed token stamped PAID IN ADVANCE.
VELVET_CHOKER.description: Gain 1 Energy. Each turn, the 7th and later cards played from your hand cost 1 more.
WAR_HAMMER.description: On pickup, choose 2 cards to upgrade. Whenever you defeat an Elite, randomly upgrade 4 cards.
WHISPERING_EARRING.description: Gain 1 Energy. During the first 3 turns of each combat, after drawing, automatically play your highest-cost playable card.

Once per turn at [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], play it to draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and record [blue]1[/blue] [gold]red-ink debt[/gold]. Each debt costs [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] at combat end (or [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP if unpaid).
A sealed token whose ink refuses to dry.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_MORVI_OVERDUE_LIB: At combat start, add [blue]3[/blue] random temporary [gold]Archive Pages[/gold] to hand. Pages cost [blue]0[/blue] and are removed after combat.
A sealed token tucked behind the last shelf.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_MORVI_OPEN_BOOK_E: On turn [blue]1[/blue], draw [blue]5[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. Extra-drawn cards left in hand at turn end are sealed in the [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], then return on turn [blue]3[/blue] as [blue]0[/blue]-cost cards if hand space allows.
A sealed token folded into a cheat sheet.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_MORVI_PAPERSTORM_: At combat start, shuffle [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Waste Paper[/gold] Status cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Each turn, the first [blue]2[/blue] Status cards drawn from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] are consumed; each draws [blue]1[/blue] and grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
A sealed token caught in a rising stack of forms.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_MORVI_BLUEPRINT_P: At combat start, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Proofread[/gold]. Your first [blue]3[/blue] manually played deck cards get a one-play benefit: unupgraded cards temporarily upgrade and draw [blue]1[/blue]; upgraded cards cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
A sealed token corrected in blue pencil.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_MORVI_DEBT_SETTLE: Gain [blue]220[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, and upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards. Take [blue]320[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]. After each combat, repay [blue]40[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; for each [blue]10[/blue] short, lose [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP. [gold]Debt[/gold] drops by [blue]40[/blue] either way.
A sealed token stamped PAID IN ADVANCE.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_MIRROR_REBU: Choose [blue]1[/blue] mirror card from your deck. At combat start, move it to your hand after drawing. The first time played: [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue].
A sealed token that answers the first wound.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_MIRROR_HALL: At turn end, remember the last card type played. Next turn, your first card of that type makes [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
A sealed token reflected from every wall.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_PRESUMPTION: Start combat with [gold]Innocent[/gold]. At your turn start, if you are [gold]Innocent[/gold], draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Taking unblocked enemy [gold]Attack[/gold] damage removes [gold]Innocent[/gold], you lose [blue]8[/blue] HP immediately, and you cannot regain [gold]Innocent[/gold] for the rest of combat.
A sealed token from before evidence is heard.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_CLOSED_COUR: Post-combat card rewards no longer appear. On Turn [blue]1[/blue]: draw [blue]4[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. On Turn [blue]4[/blue]: draw [blue]2[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
A sealed token from a locked courtroom.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_DEFERRED_VE: At the start of Turn [blue]4[/blue], draw [blue]4[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. Thereafter, each non-Status card spends [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]: [gold]Attack[/gold]/[gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue] card. If combat ends before Turn [blue]4[/blue], heal [blue]4[/blue] HP.
A sealed token waiting for the third exhibit.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_DEATH_REPRI: Once per run, prevent death from a fatal hit and set HP to [blue]1[/blue]. Take one final turn: draw [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and all cards cost [blue]0[/blue]. You cannot die during this turn; if any enemies remain, die; otherwise, continue the run.
A sealed token for one delayed final sentence.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_SINGLE_SENT: Each turn, your first [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times. Afterwards, you may only play up to [blue]4[/blue] more cards this turn. [gold]Power[/gold] cards do not count towards this limit, cost [blue]0[/blue], and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
A sealed token written in one line.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_LOTHA_PUBLIC_EVID: Your non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] stacks apply twice and grant [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. Enemy non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] stacks on you also apply twice; stacks applied to you are also doubled, but remove [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. At turn start, spend up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]: each spent stack draws [blue]1[/blue] and gives [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
A sealed token laid where all can see it.
EZ_MICRO_BALANCE_RELIC_VAKUU_FIGHT_OPTIO: Fight Vakuu in a greed trial. Break [blue]1[/blue] or more [gold]Stolen Locks[/gold] to cash out loot Gold and extra blessing choices. On turns [blue]1[/blue], [blue]3[/blue], and [blue]5[/blue], choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Contracts[/gold] to help break locks at the cost of increasing [gold]Blood Debt[/gold]. You may cash out after breaking any lock. No normal combat rewards. Death ends the run.
A warning and an invitation etched on the same blade.
